name.description: Name of the target. Set as the `external_target` label and used in the ScrapeConfig names, with the exporter name appended for a preset. Must be unique in the namespace.

preset.description: Preset for a known managed service, which sets ports, labels and a curated metric allowlist. `msk`: Amazon MSK Open Monitoring.

hosts.description: Hosts to scrape. With the msk preset: broker hostnames without port. Without a preset: host:port.

path.description: Metrics path for a target without a preset. Defaults to /metrics.

scheme.description: Scheme for a target without a preset. Defaults to http.

metric.description: Regular expression for the full metric name.

labels.description: Regular expressions for label values the series must have, for example `name` on JMX metrics. Labels not listed match any value.

keepMetrics.description: Metrics to keep. Required without a preset, where nothing else is kept. With a preset they are added to the preset allowlist, including their per-topic and per-partition series.

exporters.description: Turns exporters of a preset on or off, by name. All are on by default. The msk preset has `jmx` and `node`.

labels.description: Static labels added to every series from this target, for example an environment. `namespace`, `external_target`, `job` and `instance` are reserved.

targets.description: Endpoints to scrape. Each entry renders one ScrapeConfig, or one per exporter for a preset.

scrapeInterval.description: How often each host is scraped. Can be set per target.

scrapeTimeout.description: Scrape timeout. Can be set per target.

sampleLimit.description: Maximum number of series kept per host after filtering. Can be set per target.

global.description: Included to allow the chart to be used as a subchart, as Helm injects .global from the top chart.

idp_aws_account.description: This value is set automatically by ArgoCD, but can be overridden here for local testing.

idp_oidc_provider_url.description: This value is set automatically by ArgoCD, but can be overridden here for local testing.
